 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props); ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
 print('MMFF-relaxed conformer energy (kcal/mol):',round(ff.CalcEnergy(),6))
conf=m.GetConformer()

```python
import os, numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
smi='N=CN1C2CC2OC1=N'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=20260618
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('3D embedding status:',status)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
props=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(m)
if props:
 ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(m,props); ff.Minimize(maxIts=1000)
 print('MMFF-relaxed conformer energy (kcal/mol):',round(ff.CalcEnergy(),6))
conf=m.GetConformer()
coords=np.array(conf.GetPositions())
atoms=[(a.GetSymbol(), tuple(coords[a.GetIdx()])) for a in m.GetAtoms()]
print('Atom count with hydrogens:',len(atoms))
from pyscf import gto, dft
mol=gto.M(atom=atoms, basis='def2-SVP', charge=0, spin=0, unit='Angstrom', verbose=0)
print('Electron count:',mol.nelectron)
print('Starting B3LYP/def2-SVP single point...')
from pyscf.dft import RKS
mf=RKS(mol)
mf.xc='B3LYP'
mf.conv_tol=1e-9
mf.max_cycle=200
energy=mf.kernel()
print('SCF converged:',mf.converged)
print('Total energy (Hartree):',energy)
occ=np.where(mf.mo_occ>0)[0]
homo=int(occ[-1])
print('HOMO index (0-based):',homo)
print('HOMO energy (Hartree):',float(mf.mo_energy[homo]))
print('LUMO energy (Hartree):',float(mf.mo_energy[homo+1]))

```
